newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Deep river, Conn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Deep river, Conn..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Town of Deep River, Connecticut, at Farmers & Mechanics Bank, First Floor Conference Room, 237 Main Street, Middletown, Connecticut 06457, until 11:30 A.M. (Eastern Daylight Time) on

for the purchase when issued, at not less than par and accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the date of delivery, of the whole of $4,800,000 General Obligation Bonds, Issue of 1996, payable on November 1 in each year as follows: $480,000 in each of the years 1997 through 2006. The Bonds will be qualified tax-exempt obligations'', will be certified by Farmers & Mechanics Bank, Middletown, Connecticut, and delivered against payment in Federal funds in New York, New York, on or about November 1, 1996, subject to the approving opinion of Day, Berry & Howard of Hartford, Connecticut. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book- entry system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, acting as securities depository.

Notices of Sale, Bid Forms and the Town's Official Statement may be obtained from Mr. Theodore J. May, Jr., Senior Vice President and Manager, at Farmers & Mechanics Bank, 237 Main Street, Middletown, Connecticut 06457
